profile.headline: Full Stack Developer at Travelers
profile.summary: I have worked with React, Redux, HTML 5, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Node, Express, Pg, and  SQL.  I enjoy pushing through on difficult tasks and knowing how my work fits into the bigger picture.  Problem solving and learning systems are my passion at work and in my hobbies as a gamer and rock climber.  From my prior career as a science teacher, I possess and abundance of soft skills and a reflective professional disposition focused on continuous learning.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Work on an agile team to support and develop internal software with a focus on workflow orchestration.

positions.title: Full Stack Student Developer
positions.description:
-collaborate weekly on group projects by defining tasks and supporting team members through pair programming, retrospectives, and troubleshooting
-code CRUD apps using variety of languages and libraries, mainly ReactJS/React-native, redux/saga,  JavaScript with  jQuery, Node with Express, Postgresql and third party APIs databases
-scope, code, and present personal and client full stack web applications
-active in public speaking, community building activities, and alumni network

positions.title: Science Teacher
positions.description:
-developed science curriculum for 6th grade science and high school courses
-taught student-centered lessons using group work while promoting growth mindset attitudes
-reformed and promoted STEM day with fellow staff to include full STEM projects 
-used student data to guide student/parent contact for instruction and student background

positions.title: Deli Worker
positions.description:
-balanced food production duties with courteous customer service
-trained new hires on safe food handling and efficient food production

positions.title: Laboratory Technician
positions.description:
-performed standardized methods with care to test water for organic and inorganic pollutants
-trained seasonal workers on laboratory best practices
-updated project managers, supervisor, and clients regarding progress and challenges
-worked with variety of laboratory equipment daily 
-refined methods for consistent testing by reducing impact of lab environmental variables

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
-facilitated a biweekly discussion and lab exercises for an introductory biology course
-presented on relevant topics prior to lab exercises, then monitored for safe lab conduct
-provided feedback on students' coursework to improve their learning/writing 
-discussed lab exercises with other TA's and supervisor to anticipate challenges

positions.title: Peer Tutor
positions.description:
-tutored college students in maths, biology, chemistry, physics, and writing
-helped students develop independent study skills
-led discussion with other tutors to improve tutoring practice and meet student needs
-continued tutoring professional development by attending workshops

volunteerExperiences.description: Field work and greenhouse work managing plots, and collecting plant/soil data.  Engaging students in ongoing research during outreach events in high schools.
